narrative.overview: Built Android-first for outdoor Chennai glare and one-handed barrier gate checks, Parkly Mobile brings Coromandel Sunlit Ledger onto Expo SDK 54: warm limestone surfaces (#F7F6F2), crisp elevated white cards (#FFFFFF), Harbor Navy headers (#0B1628), and Signal Crimson CTAs (#D90410), animated strictly on the UI thread via react-native-reanimated 4, react-native-gesture-handler, and expo-haptics.
keyCharacteristics: 48dp minimum interactive targets (PressScale with Android ripple + 0.97 scale settle in 120ms) and safe-area window insets across custom headers and bottom sticky bars.
Draggable Map bottom sheet driven by Gesture.Pan() + withSpring plus accessible tap header fallback.
Respects system reduced motion in Stack transitions, press curves, loading skeletons, and chat scrolling.

rules.name: The Sunlight Legibility Rule
rules.body: Avoid low-contrast dark-slate cards in outdoors use; anchor active pricing and QR gate tokens in dark #0B1628 ink on #FFFFFF and #F7F6F2 surfaces.

dos: Do guard every shared-value read/write behind .get()/.set() and run haptics from worklet handlers only via scheduleOnRN.
Do keep FlatList row items free of entering mount animations so fast scroll virtualization never glitches.
donts: Don't drop below 48dp hit size on interactive mobile controls or omit useReducedMotion() fallbacks.
Don't mix legacy #0A1425 / #0F172A / #38BDF8 dark-mode colors into sunlit screens.
